# Olivér Nagy

<div class="home-hero__role">
Quantitative Developer · Economist · Researcher
</div>
  

  
I am an **economist** turned **quantitative developer** working at the intersection of quantitative finance, econometrics, and software engineering. My professional work focuses on financial modelling in **Python** and **C++**, while my research covers volatility forecasting, asset pricing and financial-market responses to events. More broadly, I am interested in solving modelling problems with computational methods.


::: {.home-hero__focus}
Quantitative development
: Numerical methods, model implementation, financial modelling

Economics
: Monetary policy, inflation forecasting, policy evaluation

Research
: Volatility forecasting, asset pricing, event studies
